reader.requirement: NEXT GROUP NEXT PAGE is refused in a page footing report group, and accepted in groups that the other NEXT GROUP rules allow (body groups, report heading).

edition-consulted.switches: DialectLevel < 2002 adds §1985:XIII.3.16.3 SR1 (no LINE NUMBER clause); the NEXT PAGE / page footing arm carries no edition test

reader.edition-search: read BindNextGroupClauses' NextPage branch; grep ReportNextPageReset2002.
reader.behaviour-differs-by-edition: yes: only the WITH RESET phrase (2002) differs; the page-footing refusal is the same at every edition.
reader.witnesses-cover: all of the rule's range at this edition (the refusal); the accepted body-group form and the 2002 WITH RESET phrase are not in the witness

probes.printed: COBOL2284: the NEXT PAGE phrase shall not be specified in a page footing

probes.expected: accepted in a detail group; each detail followed by a page advance

probes.printed: COBOL0900: the WITH RESET phrase of NEXT GROUP NEXT PAGE requires COBOL-2002

citations.check: OK  §1985:XIII.3.16.3 SR4  (3.16.3 Syntax Rules)  the text is in SR4

reader.notes: BindNextGroupClauses checks g.Kind == PageFooting for the NextPage kind at every edition, and the 2002 WITH RESET phrase is gated. The message cites §2023:13.18.37.3 SR5 at --std 85.

refuter.evidence: Read XIII.3.16.3 SR1-SR5 and 3.10.8. Probes at --std 85: p5_pfspell (NEXT GROUP IS NEXT PAGE written before LINE and TYPE PF) COBOL2284 refused; p5_okgroups (NEXT GROUP NEXT PAGE in RH, CH, CF FINAL) exit 0; p5_rhnp (RH NEXT GROUP NEXT PAGE, FIRST DETAIL 4) RGX.TXT 'RH' FF then DE on line 4, same at --std 2023, per §1985:XIII.3.10.8 GR4b. cite.py: OK §1985:XIII.3.16.3 SR4 'the text is in SR4'; OK §1985:XIII.3.10.8 'it lies in GR4b'.
